report_discrepancies.note: Governmental funds: beginning 1,231,758 + revenues 3,155,096 - expenditures 705,147 = 3,681,707, printed ending fund balance 3,681,708 (printed net change 2,449,950). Traced to the nonmajor Miscellaneous total 379 (p9) vs Cemetery 252 + Park 126 = 378, which carries into Total expenditures 61,868 / 705,147.
Nonmajor funds: Total Nonmajor Miscellaneous 379 vs fund columns 252 + 126 = 378; total expenditures 61,868 vs 28,900 + 27,101 + 5,866 = 61,867.

Business-type: beginning 1,268,162 + sales and use fees 1,058,712 + miscellaneous 36,073 + investment earnings 3,613 - expenditures 972,611 = 1,393,949, printed ending 1,393,948 (printed revenues over expenditures 125,786). Proprietary Miscellaneous revenue total 36,073 (p8) vs columns 21,214 + 761 + 2,429 + 11,668 = 36,072.

notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5-6); expenditures are listed by object with no function, so each uses the function of its largest funds (as in FY2024) with review, Operating expenses = Operating; statement capital outlay is mixed (General 737, Street -3,546), labelled plain Capital Outlay. Pool Bond, Series 2022 2,545,000 is printed among revenues, so it is a receipt line (Bond Proceeds), not debt_proceeds. Governmental cash fields null as in FY2024 (no single printed governmental cash figure; fund balances used for the roll-forward); investments 2,667,809 printed separately (p4). Business-type lines from the proprietary funds statement (p8, Total column; aligned with FY2024 2026-11-12), Miscellaneous printed under Charges for services; note the Statement of Activities and budget schedule show Sewer 77,250/64,668 and Water 39,462/39,119, while the proprietary statement (p8) prints those figures under Water and Sewer respectively; detail follows p8 column headings. Business-type measure cash (net position consists only of cash). Business-type receipts total computed (no single printed total). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p4, totals equal the government-wide governmental column 3,681,708), business-type from p1. Detail: per fund columns of the governmental funds statement (major funds, p5-6), the nonmajor combining statement (Cemetery, Park, Keno; Police and ARPA have no activity, p9) and the proprietary funds statement (p8); the all-funds budget schedule (p10) is a combined single column and is not recorded.
